title: Wound Care Supply Program Refill Cycle Settings
content:
# Refill cycle settings — Wound Care Supply Program

Fulfillment scheduling settings for dressing refills on each tier of the Wound Care Supply Program.

| Tier | Days of supply per shipment | Refill reminder lead | Refill ship lead | Customer confirmation of each refill | Coverage reverification | Shipment consolidation span |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | 30 | 7 days | 5 days | No (subscription shipping on schedule) | 0 (no coverage to verify) | 5 days |
| Wound Care Commercial HMO Program | 30 | 7 days | 5 days | Yes | 6 months | 5 days |
| Wound Care Commercial PPO Program | 30 | 7 days | 5 days | Yes | 12 months | 5 days |
| Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program | 30 | 7 days | 5 days | Yes | 12 months | 5 days |
| Wound Care Original Medicare Program | 30 | 7 days | 5 days | Yes | 12 months | 5 days |
| Wound Care Medicaid Program | 30 | 7 days | 5 days | Yes | 1 month | 5 days |

## Setting definitions

- **Days of supply per shipment**: the standard days of supply in one dressing shipment, in calendar days; surgical dressings ship no more than one month at a time.
- **Refill reminder lead**: the earliest point for Larkfield's refill-reminder contact, in calendar days before the planned ship date.
- **Refill ship lead**: the earliest point a refill may ship, in calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of the same item.
- **Customer confirmation of each refill**: whether each refill requires the customer's own confirmation of continued use and quantity on hand before it ships; No means subscription shipping on schedule.
- **Coverage reverification**: how recently the coverage record must have been verified with the payer before a refill ships, in calendar months counted back from the ship date; 0 means no coverage to verify.
- **Shipment consolidation span**: refills for a customer's several wounds whose earliest ship dates fall within this many calendar days of each other ship together on the later date.

## Notes

- The supply days, the reminder lead, the ship lead and the consolidation span are the same on all six tiers.
- Coverage reverification is tightest on the Wound Care Medicaid Program (1 month) and loosest on the commercial PPO, Medicare Advantage and Original Medicare tiers (12 months).
